Remembering March 26
2019-03-29T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-weekend/mailbox/news/remembering-march-26-1721590

March 26 is a day of immense significance for all Bangladeshis. It was on this day in 1971, history was created by declaring the independence of this country. It was a nine-month bloody war after which we gained independence in exchange for the loss of many lives. On this glorious day, we should all promise to shun self-destructive politics and work together to build the golden Bengal that we dreamt of during the Liberation War.

Sayek Ahmed Sajib

Narayankul Dream Model School and College, Gazipur
